top_signals.title: Nigeria sets new crypto licensing rules, bans algorithmic stablecoins
top_signals.summary: Nigeria has banned algorithmic stablecoins and introduced reserve requirements for issuers as it expands central bank oversight of crypto payment services.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: European Stocks Erase Weekly Gain With Milder Swings Than the US
top_signals.summary: European stocks erased their weekly gain as concerns over the Democratic sweep of the US Congress and its implications for the AI trade triggered losses and increased volatility in global equity markets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: U.S. crude oil imports from Venezuela in July were highest since 2017
top_signals.summary: In July 2026, U.S. imports of crude oil from Venezuela averaged 701,000 barrels per day (b/d), the most since May 2017, before decreasing to 655,000 b/d in August, according to data published in our Petroleum Supply Monthly
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: China’s tech megacity cleans up seedy underbelly for Apec summit - Financial Times
top_signals.summary: China’s tech megacity cleans up seedy underbelly for Apec summit  Financial Times
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: U.S. economy added 165,000 jobs in October, way more than expected; unemployment rate slips to 4.1%
top_signals.summary: Nonfarm payrolls were expected to increase by 59,000 in October as the unemployment rate held steady at 4.2%.
